with type 2 diabetes AND heart failure,
-- admissions lasting >= 72 hours.
WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT
    a.subject_id,
    a.hadm_id,
    a.admittime,
    a.dischtime
  FROM `kltn-text-to-sql.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.admissions` a
  JOIN `kltn-text-to-sql.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients` p
    ON a.subject_id = p.subject_id
  WHERE
    LOWER(p.gender) = 'female'
    AND p.anchor_age BETWEEN 50 AND 60
    AND DATETIME_DIFF(a.dischtime, a.admittime, HOUR) >= 72
    -- must have a diabetes diagnosis (ICD-10 E11* or ICD-9 250*)
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM `kltn-text-to-sql.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.diagnoses_icd` d
      WHERE d.hadm_id = a.hadm_id
        AND (
          (d.icd_version = 10 AND SAFE_CAST(d.icd_code AS STRING) LIKE 'E11%')
          OR (d.icd_version = 9 AND SAFE_CAST(d.icd_code AS STRING) LIKE '250%')
        )
    )
    -- must have a heart failure diagnosis (ICD-10 I50* or ICD-9 428*)
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM `kltn-text-to-sql.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.diagnoses_icd` d2
      WHERE d2.hadm_id = a.hadm_id
        AND (
          (d2.icd_version = 10 AND SAFE_CAST(d2.icd_code AS STRING) LIKE 'I50%')
          OR (d2.icd_version = 9 AND SAFE_CAST(d2.icd_code AS STRING) LIKE '428%')
        )
    )
),

-- Consolidate GLP-1 medication events from prescriptions, pharmacy, and emar.
glp_med_events AS (
  -- prescriptions.drug (starttime)
  SELECT
    subject_id,
    hadm_id,
    starttime AS med_time,
    drug AS med_name
  FROM `kltn-text-to-sql.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.prescriptions`
  WHERE starttime IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      LOWER(COALESCE(drug, '')) LIKE '%exenatide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(drug, '')) LIKE '%liraglutide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(drug, '')) LIKE '%dulaglutide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(drug, '')) LIKE '%semaglutide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(drug, '')) LIKE '%lixisenatide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(drug, '')) LIKE '%albiglutide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(drug, '')) LIKE '%tirzepatide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(drug, '')) LIKE '%byetta%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(drug, '')) LIKE '%victoza%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(drug, '')) LIKE '%trulicity%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(drug, '')) LIKE '%ozempic%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(drug, '')) LIKE '%rybelsus%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(drug, '')) LIKE '%lyxumia%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(drug, '')) LIKE '%tanzeum%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(drug, '')) LIKE '%mounjaro%'
    )

  UNION ALL

  -- pharmacy.medication (starttime)
  SELECT
    subject_id,
    hadm_id,
    starttime AS med_time,
    medication AS med_name
  FROM `kltn-text-to-sql.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.pharmacy`
  WHERE starttime IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%exenatide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%liraglutide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%dulaglutide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%semaglutide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%lixisenatide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%albiglutide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%tirzepatide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%byetta%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%victoza%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%trulicity%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%ozempic%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%rybelsus%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%lyxumia%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%tanzeum%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%mounjaro%'
    )

  UNION ALL

  -- emar.medication (charttime = administration)
  SELECT
    subject_id,
    hadm_id,
    charttime AS med_time,
    medication AS med_name
  FROM `kltn-text-to-sql.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.emar`
  WHERE charttime IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%exenatide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%liraglutide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%dulaglutide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%semaglutide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%lixisenatide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%albiglutide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%tirzepatide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%byetta%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%victoza%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%trulicity%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%ozempic%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%rybelsus%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%lyxumia%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%tanzeum%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%mounjaro%'
    )
),

-- Per-admission flags based on events and admission times
per_admission_flags AS (
  SELECT
    c.subject_id,
    c.hadm_id,
    c.admittime,
    c.dischtime,

    -- baseline: any GLP-1 med event strictly before admittime
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM glp_med_events m
      WHERE m.hadm_id = c.hadm_id
        AND m.med_time < c.admittime
    ) AS baseline_glp,

    -- earliest in-admission GLP-1 time (>= admittime)
    (
      SELECT MIN(m.med_time) FROM glp_med_events m
      WHERE m.hadm_id = c.hadm_id
        AND m.med_time >= c.admittime
    ) AS first_in_admission_glp_time,

    -- any GLP-1 event <= admittime + 72 hours (this counts pre-admission events too)
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM glp_med_events m
      WHERE m.hadm_id = c.hadm_id
        AND m.med_time <= DATETIME_ADD(c.admittime, INTERVAL 72 HOUR)
    ) AS glp_by_72h

  FROM cohort c
)

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS n_patients,
  SUM(CASE WHEN baseline_glp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_baseline,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN baseline_glp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS baseline_pct,
  SUM(CASE
        WHEN NOT baseline_glp
         AND first_in_admission_glp_time IS NOT NULL
         AND DATETIME_DIFF(first_in_admission_glp_time, admittime, HOUR) <= 12
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_initiation_first_12h,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE
        WHEN NOT baseline_glp
         AND first_in_admission_glp_time IS NOT NULL
         AND DATETIME_DIFF(first_in_admission_glp_time, admittime, HOUR) <= 12
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS initiation_first_12h_pct,
  SUM(CASE WHEN glp_by_72h THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_final_72h,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN glp_by_72h THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS final_72h_pct,
  ROUND(
    (100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN glp_by_72h THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*))
    -
    (100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN baseline_glp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*))
  , 2) AS net_percentage_point_change
FROM per_admission_flags;

  FROM `kltn-text-to-sql.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.admissions` a
  JOIN `kltn-text-to-sql.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients` p
    ON a.subject_id = p.subject_id
  WHERE
    p.gender = 'F'
    AND p.anchor_age BETWEEN 50 AND 60
    AND DATETIME_DIFF(a.dischtime, a.admittime, HOUR) >= 72
    -- must have a diabetes diagnosis (ICD-10 E11* or ICD-9 250*)
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM `kltn-text-to-sql.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.diagnoses_icd` d
      WHERE d.hadm_id = a.hadm_id
        AND (
          (d.icd_version = 10 AND d.icd_code LIKE 'E11%')
          OR (d.icd_version = 9 AND d.icd_code LIKE '250%')
        )
    )
    -- must have a heart failure diagnosis (ICD-10 I50* or ICD-9 428*)
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM `kltn-text-to-sql.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.diagnoses_icd` d2
      WHERE d2.hadm_id = a.hadm_id
        AND (
          (d2.icd_version = 10 AND d2.icd_code LIKE 'I50%')
          OR (d2.icd_version = 9 AND d2.icd_code LIKE '428%')
        )
    )
),

-- Consolidate GLP-1 medication events from prescriptions, pharmacy, and emar.
glp_med_events AS (
  -- prescriptions.drug (starttime)
  SELECT
    subject_id,
    hadm_id,
    starttime AS med_time,
    drug AS med_name
  FROM `kltn-text-to-sql.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.prescriptions`
  WHERE starttime IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      LOWER(COALESCE(drug, '')) LIKE '%exenatide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(drug, '')) LIKE '%liraglutide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(drug, '')) LIKE '%dulaglutide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(drug, '')) LIKE '%semaglutide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(drug, '')) LIKE '%lixisenatide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(drug, '')) LIKE '%albiglutide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(drug, '')) LIKE '%tirzepatide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(drug, '')) LIKE '%byetta%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(drug, '')) LIKE '%victoza%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(drug, '')) LIKE '%trulicity%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(drug, '')) LIKE '%ozempic%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(drug, '')) LIKE '%rybelsus%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(drug, '')) LIKE '%lyxumia%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(drug, '')) LIKE '%tanzeum%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(drug, '')) LIKE '%mounjaro%'
    )

  UNION ALL

  -- pharmacy.medication (starttime)
  SELECT
    subject_id,
    hadm_id,
    starttime AS med_time,
    medication AS med_name
  FROM `kltn-text-to-sql.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.pharmacy`
  WHERE starttime IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%exenatide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%liraglutide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%dulaglutide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%semaglutide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%lixisenatide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%albiglutide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%tirzepatide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%byetta%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%victoza%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%trulicity%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%ozempic%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%rybelsus%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%lyxumia%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%tanzeum%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%mounjaro%'
    )

  UNION ALL

  -- emar.medication (charttime = administration)
  SELECT
    subject_id,
    hadm_id,
    charttime AS med_time,
    medication AS med_name
  FROM `kltn-text-to-sql.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.emar`
  WHERE charttime IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%exenatide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%liraglutide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%dulaglutide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%semaglutide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%lixisenatide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%albiglutide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%tirzepatide%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%byetta%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%victoza%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%trulicity%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%ozempic%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%rybelsus%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%lyxumia%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%tanzeum%'
      OR LOWER(COALESCE(medication, '')) LIKE '%mounjaro%'
    )
),

-- Per-admission flags based on events and admission times
per_admission_flags AS (
  SELECT
    c.subject_id,
    c.hadm_id,
    c.admittime,
    c.dischtime,

    -- baseline: any GLP-1 med event strictly before admittime
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM glp_med_events m
      WHERE m.hadm_id = c.hadm_id
        AND m.med_time < c.admittime
    ) AS baseline_glp,

    -- earliest in-admission GLP-1 time (>= admittime)
    (
      SELECT MIN(m.med_time) FROM glp_med_events m
      WHERE m.hadm_id = c.hadm_id
        AND m.med_time >= c.admittime
    ) AS first_in_admission_glp_time,

    -- any GLP-1 event <= admittime + 72 hours (this counts pre-admission events too)
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM glp_med_events m
      WHERE m.hadm_id = c.hadm_id
        AND m.med_time <= DATETIME_ADD(c.admittime, INTERVAL 72 HOUR)
    ) AS glp_by_72h

  FROM cohort c
)

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS n_patients,
  SUM(CASE WHEN baseline_glp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_baseline,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN baseline_glp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS baseline_pct,
  SUM(CASE
        WHEN NOT baseline_glp
         AND first_in_admission_glp_time IS NOT NULL
         AND DATETIME_DIFF(first_in_admission_glp_time, admittime, HOUR) <= 12
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_initiation_first_12h,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE
        WHEN NOT baseline_glp
         AND first_in_admission_glp_time IS NOT NULL
         AND DATETIME_DIFF(first_in_admission_glp_time, admittime, HOUR) <= 12
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS initiation_first_12h_pct,
  SUM(CASE WHEN glp_by_72h THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_final_72h,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN glp_by_72h THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS final_72h_pct,
  ROUND(
    (100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN glp_by_72h THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*))
    -
    (100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN baseline_glp THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*))
  , 2) AS net_percentage_point_change
FROM per_admission_flags;
